newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cypriot court jails Arabs for illegal entry.
newsitem.headline: Cypriot court jails Arabs for illegal entry.

text.p: Two Lebanese men were jailed in Cyprus on Friday on charges of bringing illegal Arab immigrants to the island and dropping them off in shallow waters along the coast.

Boat owner El Hasa Moustafa Hassa Katter, 31, was jailed for 18 months by a district court convening in the southern town of Larnaca, and his assistant Hilal Mohammad Carhourd was jailed for 12 months.
The two were accused of bringing 13 illegal Syrian immigrants to the island on their small vessel last week. The Syrians, who have been picked up by police, had each paid Katter $300 for the trip.
Official estimates put the number of illegal immigrants on the island at 10,000. Most are Arabs, Asians and eastern Europeans.
